actions.description: Acquire an optical or mass spectrum over a declared wavelength or mass range and return the axis and intensity arrays, or an artifact reference for large spectra.

inputs.description: Lower bound of the returned wavelength range
inputs.name: wavelength_min

inputs.description: Upper bound of the returned wavelength range
inputs.name: wavelength_max

actions.name: acquire_spectrum

adjusts.description: Number of frames the spectrometer averages in hardware
adjusts.name: hardware_average

adjusts.description: Enable the input hardware trigger; false selects free running
adjusts.name: input_hw_trigger_enabled

adjusts.description: Average immediately on one trigger event instead of requiring a trigger for every frame
adjusts.name: input_hw_trigger_average_no_wait

adjusts.description: Use the falling edge of the input trigger instead of the rising edge
adjusts.name: input_hw_trigger_falling_edge

adjusts.description: Delay of the output hardware trigger in milliseconds; a negative value schedules the acquisition after the trigger
adjusts.name: output_hw_trigger_delay

facts.text: SpectrometerWrapper is the upstream handle around the Compact Spectrometer SDK instance and stores it in self.spectrometer
get_device_id returns the SDK DeviceId string
set_manual_exposure takes an exposure time in milliseconds and returns the result of SetManualExposureAsync
get_manual_exposure returns ManualExposure rounded to 2 decimals
set_hardware_average takes a frame count and returns the result of SetHwAverageAsync
get_hardware_average returns HwAverage as an int
acquire_single_spectrum returns wavelength and intensity lists, SensorExposureMs rounded to 2 decimals, and HardwareAverage
set_shutter passes open_position to SetShutterAsync, waits 0.04 s, and returns its result
set_input_hw_trigger takes enabled, ave_no_wait and slope_falling_edge flags and returns the result of SetInputHwTriggerAsync
get_input_hw_trigger_state returns HwTriggerIn, HwTriggerInAveNoWait and HwTriggerInSlope
set_output_hw_trigger_delay takes a delay in milliseconds; the docstring says a negative value schedules acquisition start after the output trigger
get_output_hw_trigger_delay returns HwTriggerOutDelayMs rounded to 2 decimals
PyCCT.discover_devices returns the known device connection keys or an empty list
PyCCT.connect_to_device returns a SpectrometerWrapper around GetCompactSpectrographById or None

measures.description: Device id reported by the Compact Spectrometer SDK
measures.name: device_id

operator_required.name: manual_exposure
operator_required.reason: the clone names milliseconds as the unit of the exposure time (src/components/pyCCT/pyCCT.py:247) but states no minimum or maximum; the site supplies the range of its spectrometer

operator_required.name: hardware_average
operator_required.reason: the clone names frames as the unit of the hardware average (src/components/pyCCT/pyCCT.py:268-270) but states no minimum or maximum; the site supplies the range of its spectrometer

operator_required.name: output_hw_trigger_delay
operator_required.reason: the clone names milliseconds as the unit of the output-trigger delay (src/components/pyCCT/pyCCT.py:380) and permits negative values (src/components/pyCCT/pyCCT.py:377), but states no minimum or maximum; the site supplies the range

operator_required.name: acquire_spectrum
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone states the wavelength range of the detector; the site supplies the range it will allow for its spectrometer

operator_required.name: acquire_spectrum
